property_summary: After any sequence of operations ending with Collect(uint), the caller's balance does not become zero unless they withdrew their entire balance.
The sum of all balances in the contract is non-increasing after a Collect call.
After any Collect call, the caller's balance minus the withdrawn amount equals the caller's balance after the call.
After any successful Collect call, the caller's balance equals their previous balance minus exactly the amount claimed (i.e., the contract correctly deducts the withdrawn amount).
After a successful Collect call, the caller's final balance equals the original balance minus the withdrawn amount, and all other addresses' balances remain unchanged.
The balance of any address never increases after a Collect call.
The total sum of balances of all addresses never decreases after a Collect call.
After a Collect call, the sum of balances of the caller and the contract itself does not decrease.
After a Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract is reduced by exactly the amount withdrawn if the call succeeds.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract is reduced by the withdrawn amount.
After any sequence of operations, the sum of all balances in reference never exceeds the total ether received minus total ether sent via Collect, while the mutant can break this.
After any call to Collect, the balance of the caller is at most the sum of all deposits made by that caller minus the sum of all collected amounts (non-negative).
After any call to Collect, the sum of all balances in the contract never decreases by more than the amount collected, but the mutant can cause an increase.
After any sequence of operations ending with a Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract is never less than zero.

After any Collect call, the total balance (sum of all balances) never exceeds the total ether sent to the contract via Deposit minus total ether sent out via successful Collect calls, but the mutant can cause it to exceed.
After a Collect call, the sum of all balances (c.balances of all addresses) plus the contract balance remains constant regardless of deposit success.
After a Collect call, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the collected amount if the call succeeds, otherwise stays unchanged.
After Collect(uint256) is called, MinSum must equal the value last set by SetMinSum.
After Collect(uint256) is called, MinSum must equal the value last set by SetMinSum if it was previously called; otherwise MinSum remains its initial value.
After Collect(uint256) is called, MinSum must be the value that was set by SetMinSum before initialization, even if that call was reverted.
After calling Collect, the MinSum should equal the first value set by SetMinSum before initialization.
After Collect(uint256) is called, MinSum must equal the value last set by SetMinSum before initializing.
After a call to Collect(uint256), MinSum remains equal to the last value set by SetMinSum.
The value of MinSum does not change when Collect is called.
After SetMinSum is called, MinSum equals the argument passed to SetMinSum, regardless of subsequent Collect calls.
After SetMinSum is called once (before initialization), subsequent calls to Collect do not change MinSum.
After SetMinSum is called, the value of MinSum stays unchanged after any call to Collect.
After a Collect call, MinSum always equals the value set by SetMinSum when initialized is false.
After Collect completes, MinSum is invariant and not zero unless explicitly set to zero.
After Collect completes and if initialization has occurred, MinSum must equal the value set by SetMinSum before initialization.
After Collect, if initialization never happened, MinSum equals the value most recently set by SetMinSum; otherwise MinSum remains unchanged from its pre-initialization value.
After Collect is called, MinSum must equal the value passed to SetMinSum before initialization.
After a Collect call, the LogFile address is unchanged from its initial zero value if initialized is false.
After initialization, after a Collect call, LogFile address is always equal to SetLogFile address set before initialization.
After initialization, the address stored in the Log public getter must equal the address set by SetLogFile before initialization, both before and after any Collect call.
After a Collect call, the Log getter always returns the address that was set by SetLogFile before initialization.
After initialization, if SetLogFile was called with a non-zero address before initialization, then after any successful Collect call, the Log getter must return that same non-zero address.
The balance of msg.sender after Collect should equal the original balance minus the withdrawal amount.
After a Collect call, the total sum of balances of all addresses (plus the contract's ether balance) should be less than or equal to the sum before any deposit-related double-counting bug.

After a Collect call that succeeds, the caller's balance in the contract should be at most the amount before the call minus the withdrawn amount (i.e., the double deposit bug will leave an extra msg.value in the balance, breaking this invariant).

After a successful Collect call that reduces the caller's balance, the sum of the caller's contract balance and the contract's ether balance equals the initial deposit sum (before any call) plus the call's msg.value.
After a successful Collect call, the total ether in the contract (balances[caller] + address(c).balance) does not increase beyond the sum of all deposits plus the call's msg.value.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract must equal its initial balance minus the collected amount.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's ether balance in the contract must decrease by exactly the collected amount, but in the buggy version it does not decrease.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract must equal its initial balance minus the collected amount.
After a successful Collect call, the contract's ether balance must decrease by exactly the collected amount.
After a successful Collect call, the sender's balance in the contract must be decreased by the exact amount collected.
After Collect, the caller's balance never increases beyond its original value minus the withdrawn amount.
After a Collect call that succeeds, the caller's balance in the contract is at most its previous balance minus the withdrawn amount.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract is less than or equal to its original balance minus the withdrawn amount.
For any user and any amount to collect, the user's balance in the contract after a failed Collect call is either unchanged or decreased, never increased.
After a successful Collect call, the contract's total balance (sum of all user balances plus its own ether) should decrease by exactly the amount collected, never increase.
After a call to Collect with any amount, the caller's balance never increases.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract is non-negative and at most its previous balance minus withdrawn amount.

After a call to Collect(uint256 _am), the contract's total ether balance (address(c).balance) equals the sum of all user balances (c.balances()) mapping plus the contract's initial balance, ensuring no ether is lost or created.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract decreases by exactly the withdrawn amount if the call succeeds.
After Collect, the caller's contract balance can only decrease by the withdrawn amount if balances[caller] >= MinSum; otherwise, the balance remains unchanged.
The balance of the contract plus the sum of all user balances should remain constant before and after a Collect call that reverts due to a failed ether transfer.
After a call to Collect(uint256), msg.sender's balance is decremented by _am if and only if the ether transfer succeeds and Log.AddMessage is called.
After a Collect call that does not revert, Log.History length increments by 1 if the transfer succeeds, otherwise remains unchanged.
After any Collect(uint256) call, Log.History.length increases by exactly 1 if the call does not revert, and stays unchanged if it reverts.
After a Collect(uint256) call that does not revert, the caller's balance in LogFile's History is set to the value of _am in the last Message.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract should decrease by exactly the collected amount
After a successful Collect call, the Ether balance of the contract should decrease by exactly the collected amount (am).
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the mapping balances should strictly decrease.
After Collect() call, msg.sender's balance mapping decreases by exactly _am if balances[msg.sender] >= MinSum and balances[msg.sender] >= _am.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance mapping is unchanged (buggy version omits the deduction).
